name: docs
description: Generate and refresh documentation from the code itself — any project, any stack. Detects the project, stack, and audience segment before writing, and traces every factual claim to code read during the run.

projectProfilesRoot.title: Project profiles directory
projectProfilesRoot.description: Directory of project-profile files recording per-repository segmentation facts (site or tenant identifiers, view conventions, tenancy model). Read during audience detection to avoid re-deriving them each run. When unset, the agent searches the repository and — only if segmentation would change what it writes — asks where those details live, offering to scaffold a profile from its template rather than guessing an audience.

teamStandardsRoot.title: Team standards docs root
teamStandardsRoot.description: Root of your team's documentation standards. Outranks this plugin's own standards layer wherever the two disagree; both are outranked by the code itself, since documentation is the artifact nobody re-verifies. When unset, the plugin layer applies and that is stated in the final report.
